habitat: Nostalgia compilations and 'the internet in 2011' retrospectives; rarely produced new.
diet: Fed on universally recognizable emotional beats, rendered in a shared, deliberately crude house style.
predators: None. This class simply stopped being made once the panel format fell out of fashion, rather than being suppressed.
transmission: Hand-assembled multi-panel comics drawn from a shared library of stock faces, hosted on forums that mostly no longer exist.
cause_of_death: Format fatigue — faster meme formats (single-image macros, then GIFs) out-competed the multi-panel comic for attention.
resurrection: Occasional and purely nostalgic; the format is referenced, not actively revived.
host_population: Historical: peaked on 4chan, reddit's early years, and FunnyJunk.
mutation: High during its active period, when new faces were constantly added; mutation stopped when production stopped.
prognosis: Extinct as a living format. Individually famous faces (see M13 Trollface, filed separately per the register's own note) outlived the genre that produced them.
rights_holder: Mostly unattributed; some panels derive from published manga
enforcement_history: None found for the anonymous faces.
curatorial_note: Treat as a class, not as one object, and exclude any face traceable to a published source. Trollface is the named exception and is filed separately at M13.
